createCourse.keywords: course, new, create, schedule, room, assign teacher
createCourse.q: How do I create a new course?
createCourse.intro: A new course takes a few steps:
createCourse.s1: Open Courses in the sidebar and click “Create course”.
createCourse.s2: Enter the course name (e.g. German B2) and optionally a subject or level.
createCourse.s3: Choose the course type: Group course (several students, shared attendance list) or Individual lesson (1:1, highlighted in the weekly schedule).
createCourse.s4: Choose the teacher and, if needed, the room (e.g. Room 1, Online Zoom).
createCourse.s5: Set the lesson days and times (e.g. Monday and Wednesday, 18:00–19:30).
createCourse.s6: Add students under “Assign students” using the search.

courseScheduling.keywords: schedule, weekly, timetable, times, room change, duration
courseScheduling.q: How do I change recurring course times in the weekly schedule?
courseScheduling.intro: Times are managed in the course settings and appear in the weekly schedule automatically:
courseScheduling.s1: Open Courses and click “Edit” on the course.
courseScheduling.s2: Add as many weekdays as you need, each with a start and end time (e.g. Tue 10:00–11:30 and Thu 10:00–11:30).
courseScheduling.s3: If two courses overlap in the same room, saving is blocked.
courseScheduling.s4: In the <accent>weekly schedule on the dashboard</accent> you can filter by teacher or course type.

rooms.keywords: rooms, room, classroom, online, zoom, occupancy, location
rooms.q: How do I create and manage rooms?
rooms.intro: Rooms assign courses to a classroom or an online meeting:
rooms.s2: Click “Add room” and enter a name (e.g. Room 101, Online Zoom A).
rooms.s3: Assign the room when you edit a course.
rooms.s4: The room shows on every course card in the weekly schedule.

portal.keywords: portal, teacher portal, own courses, log lessons, attendance
portal.q: What does a teacher see in “My Portal”?
portal.intro: Teachers get a simplified view without access to school finances or other teachers:
portal.s1: After login, My Portal opens right away.
portal.s2: The teacher sees their own weekly schedule, assigned courses and student lists.
portal.s3: With <accent>“Record lesson”</accent> they enter the topic covered and mark attendance.

importStudents.keywords: import, csv, excel, students, bulk, file, spreadsheet, template
importStudents.q: How do I import students from CSV or Excel?
importStudents.intro: Student lists from Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets can be imported in one go:
importStudents.s2: Click <accent>“Import students”</accent> at the top right.
importStudents.s3: Download the template. It has the columns First name, Last name, Email, Phone, Course.
importStudents.s4: Fill in your data and drop the file into the upload area.
importStudents.s5: Check the preview and confirm with “Import now”.
importStudents.tip: Tip: If a course named in the file doesn’t exist yet, the system can create it for you.

attendance.keywords: attendance, register, absent, excused, absences, late
attendance.q: How do attendance and absences work?
attendance.intro: For every lesson you record who took part:
attendance.absentDesc: Unexcused absence. Shows a warning in the weekly schedule.
attendance.markBody: If a lesson is in the past and at least one student was absent without excuse, the course card shows a <alert>red marker</alert>. Click the course to see who was absent.

monthlyFees.keywords: monthly fee, subscription, payment, paid, open, fees, money
monthlyFees.q: How are monthly fees calculated and recorded?
monthlyFees.intro: The school works with a monthly subscription:
monthlyFees.s1: Each student has a fixed monthly fee (e.g. €120.00 per month).
monthlyFees.s2: In the student overview and the dashboard finance module you see the status for the current month: <ok>Paid</ok> or <warn>Open</warn>.
monthlyFees.s3: When a payment arrives (transfer, standing order or cash), click “Record payment” in the student’s row.
monthlyFees.s4: The amount counts as paid immediately and feeds into the revenue statistics.

payroll.keywords: fee, teacher, hourly rate, payroll, salary, wage, payout
payroll.q: How do I calculate teacher pay?
payroll.intro: Pay is based on the hours taught and the teacher’s hourly rate:
payroll.formula: Lesson hours × hourly rate (€/h) = monthly pay (€)
payroll.outro: Under Teachers you can open a teacher’s file, see hours per month and create payroll reports.
